description: Historie ab 2008 - Summe Einspeisung Mittelspannung (Berlin) is a dataset listed in German national open data portal (GovData), an open data portal, published or maintained by Berlin Open Data. Historische Lastgänge ab 2008. Die Summe aller Einspeisungen ist die Summe der Einspeisungen von dezentralen Erzeugungsanlagen und der Einspeisungen aus benachbarten Netzen gleicher Netzebene in das Mittelspannungsnetz. Diese werden entweder gemessen (zum Beispiel bei EEG über 500 kW) oder über Einspeiseprofile (zum Beispiel Kleinkraftwerke, EEG unter 500 kW) ermittelt. Coverage: Berlin Open Data. The portal files it under the publisher Berlin Open Data. Its tags are benachbarte_netze, dezentrale_erzeugungsanlagen, einspeisung, netzeinspeisung, veröffentlichung_nach_enwg. It offers 1 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/XLSX. The portal shows 2026-01-22 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-de-portal.
